name: local-model-toolkit
description: Local model operation guidance, bounded LM Studio CLI use, task-fit evaluation, and reproducible benchmark methods.

interface.shortDescription: Use local models safely and measure their real task fit.
interface.longDescription: CLI-first local model operation through a recipient-configured LM Studio installation, with bounded loading, single-model isolation, task-fit routing, benchmark receipts, and conditional UI guidance. Hardware compatibility is a starting signal; measured usefulness, latency, memory and failure modes decide routing.
defaultPrompt: Run a bounded local-model task and preserve a verifiable receipt.
Compare local models against representative work tasks.
Choose a local model by capability, context, speed and reliability.
